title: Hot Wheels: Beat That!
summary: Hot Wheels: Beat That! is a racing video game released in September 2007 and based on the Hot Wheels toy line manufactured by Mattel. The game was developed by Eutechnyx and published by Activision.

title: Action Cycles
summary: Action Cycles formerly known as (Motorcycles Friction Motorized) was a series of larger-scale (approximately 1:12-1:18 scale) Hot Wheels motorcycles produced from 1987 to about 1997/98, initially under the Hot Wheels Giants line. title: Hot Wheels Classics
summary:
200px|right
Hot Wheels Classics is an annual line of Hot Wheels cars first released in 2005. They are marketed towards adult collectors and were originally priced around $3.99 (USD). Each car features a metal base and is released in several different Spectraflame colors.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
